children: Opposition to AI data centers is spreading beyond the US, with residents in Australia, South Korea, Japan and Malaysia challenging projects near their homes. Goodman has dropped Project Mars in Sydney’s Lane Cove suburb after local backlash, according to BeInCrypto, while Victoria has introduced new rules requiring data centers to supply their own renewable energy, avoid drinking water for cooling and sit at least 150 meters from homes. In the US, local resistance blocked or delayed about 120 projects worth nearly $200 billion in the first half of 2026.

title: Data Center Opposition Spreads Across Australia, Asia And Europe
